restated: An adversary with existing access to Windows hosts on this network harvested credentials from those hosts.
what_would_confirm: LSASS memory access by non-standard processes, SAM/NTDS.dit or registry hive dumps, use of credential-dumping tools (e.g., Mimikatz, procdump on lsass), suspicious access to DPAPI secrets or browser credential stores, or anomalous authentication with harvested credentials.
what_would_refute: No process access to LSASS, no credential store or registry hive reads/dumps, no credential-dumping tool execution, and no anomalous authentication activity on the affected Windows hosts.
